paragraphs.zh: 18. 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione consisting of at least 90 wt. % of crystalline form A of claim 16.
paragraphs.en: 18. 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione consisting of at least 90 wt. % of crystalline form A of claim 16.
paragraphs.notes: First claim on the page; it begins and ends here, nothing is carried over from p14. Depends on claim 16. Line-break hyphenation rejoined; every hyphen kept here is printed inside a line on the image. Source language is English, so en carries the same text as zh with no translation applied. The OCR layer flattens the square brackets of 2-[2-chloro... to a bare hyphen (2-2-chloro) and reads the locant commas of 2,2,2- as full stops (2.2.2-); the image wins on both, in this claim and in every other claim on the page. The OCR layer also drops the space in wt. % to wt.%; the image prints wt. % with a space throughout.

paragraphs.zh:
19. A process for the production of the crystalline form A of claim 16, comprising:
i) preparing a solution of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione in a polar organic solvent which is selected from the group consisting of cyclic ethers, acetonitrile, methanol, nitromethane, acetic acid, methyl ethyl ketone, pyridine and dimethyl sulfoxide, and
ii) effecting a crystallization of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione
thereby obtaining the crystalline form A of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione.
paragraphs.en:
19. A process for the production of the crystalline form A of claim 16, comprising:
i) preparing a solution of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione in a polar organic solvent which is selected from the group consisting of cyclic ethers, acetonitrile, methanol, nitromethane, acetic acid, methyl ethyl ketone, pyridine and dimethyl sulfoxide, and
ii) effecting a crystallization of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione
thereby obtaining the crystalline form A of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione.
paragraphs.notes: Depends on claim 16. Printed as an indented two-item list, i) and ii), followed by an unnumbered 'thereby obtaining' clause; the three parts are kept on separate lines here and no blank line separates them. The compound name in this claim prints a hyphen before benzoyl, which claim 18 does not; both are recorded as printed. Note the comma in 'claim 16, comprising:', which the parallel claim 23 does not have.

paragraphs.zh: 20. A crystalline form C of 2-[2-chloro-4-methyl-sulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]-cyclohexan-1,3-dione, which in an X-ray powder diffraction diagram at 25° C. and Cu-Kα radiation displays at least 3 of the following reflections, quoted as 2θ values: 7.4±0.2°, 10.8±0.2°, 14.8±0.2°, 16.6±0.2°, 21.1±0.2°, 21.6±0.2° and 33.6±0.2°.
paragraphs.en: 20. A crystalline form C of 2-[2-chloro-4-methyl-sulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]-cyclohexan-1,3-dione, which in an X-ray powder diffraction diagram at 25° C. and Cu-Kα radiation displays at least 3 of the following reflections, quoted as 2θ values: 7.4±0.2°, 10.8±0.2°, 14.8±0.2°, 16.6±0.2°, 21.1±0.2°, 21.6±0.2° and 33.6±0.2°.
paragraphs.notes: Independent claim, and the second of the two form claims; the crystalline form C counterpart of claim 16 (form A) on the previous page. All seven 2theta values were read off the image at 3x magnification and the OCR layer disagrees on three of them: the layer gives '14.8+0.29' for 14.8±0.2° (it swallowed the degree sign across the line break, where the image prints '14.8±0.' at the end of one line and '2°,' at the start of the next), '21.10.2°' for 21.1±0.2° (it lost the plus-minus), and '7.4+0.2°' style plus signs for every ±. The image wins in all cases. The name in this claim is hyphenated differently again, '4-methyl-sulfonyl' and 'benzoyl]-cyclohexan', and is recorded as printed. The page prints 'Cu' and 'Kα' joined by a long dash; it is transcribed here as a plain hyphen because the repo forbids the em dash character. The OCR layer reads that as 'Cu' then a long dash then 'KC.' (the long dash is written out in words here rather than quoted, because the repo forbids the character). The Greek theta and alpha are kept because they are the printed notation. 'at 25° C.' has a space before the C and a full stop after it, as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 21. The crystalline form C of claim 20 with a content of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione of at least 94 wt. %.
paragraphs.en: 21. The crystalline form C of claim 20 with a content of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione of at least 94 wt. %.
paragraphs.notes: Depends on claim 20. 94 wt. % checked on the image; the purity threshold here differs from the 90 wt. % used in claims 18, 22, 24, 28, 32 and 33.

paragraphs.zh: 22. 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]-cyclohexan-1,3-dione consisting of at least 90 wt. % of crystalline form C of claim 20.
paragraphs.en: 22. 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]-cyclohexan-1,3-dione consisting of at least 90 wt. % of crystalline form C of claim 20.
paragraphs.notes: Depends on claim 20. The form C counterpart of claim 18. The name prints 'benzoyl]-cyclohexan' with a hyphen, where claim 18 prints 'benzoyl]cyclohexan' without one; recorded as printed.

paragraphs.zh:
23. A process for the production of the crystalline form C of claim 20 comprising:
i) preparing a hot solution of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione in 2,2-dimethyl-propanol or in an aromatic hydrocarbon or in a mixture of an aromatic hydrocarbon with an aliphatic hydrocarbon, and
ii) effecting a crystallization of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione by cooling of the solution
thereby obtaining the crystalline form C of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione.
paragraphs.en:
23. A process for the production of the crystalline form C of claim 20 comprising:
i) preparing a hot solution of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione in 2,2-dimethyl-propanol or in an aromatic hydrocarbon or in a mixture of an aromatic hydrocarbon with an aliphatic hydrocarbon, and
ii) effecting a crystallization of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione by cooling of the solution
thereby obtaining the crystalline form C of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione.
paragraphs.notes: Depends on claim 20. The claim runs across the column break: the preamble, i) and ii) are at the foot of the left column and the 'thereby obtaining' clause is at the head of the right column. Solvent read off the image as '2,2-dimethyl-propanol', hyphenated as printed. 'by cooling of the solution' has a lower-case s on the image; the OCR layer capitalises it to 'Solution', and likewise capitalises 'zoyl]' to 'Zoyl]' where the name breaks across a line. No comma before 'comprising:' here, unlike claim 19.
